skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent forms with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract numerators while keeping the common denominator, and simplify the result if needed.

skills.name: Separate and subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Separate whole and fraction parts of mixed numbers, then subtract the whole parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When fraction subtraction yields a negative result, borrow 1 from the whole part, convert it to a fraction with the same denominator, and adjust the fraction before subtracting.

skills.name: Combine whole and fraction results
skills.definition: Write the final answer as a mixed number or integer by combining the whole part and fraction part.
